name: hey-js
description: HTTP load generator — JavaScript port of rakyll/hey

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('node:fs').readdirSync('.',{recursive:true})) if (/\\.(js|mjs)$/.test(f) && !f.startsWith('node_modules')) require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f]);" && echo 'node --check: all files OK'
scripts.verify: npm run test:corpus && npm run test:baseline && npm test
